factory.description: The Factory screens: 내 차례 with its top item open, the graph and a Task page, beside the shell's sidebar with the Factory row and the 비서 row.

states.rest: 내 차례 at rest: the first item open with its suggestion picked, nothing hovered or focused.
states.board: 보드: four lanes by movement, 시작 전 · 진행 중 · 멈춤 (나를 기다림, 다른 걸 기다림) · 완료, with the narrow lanes drawing their cards small and old completions folded.
states.graph: 그래프: layered Tasks with arrows, none for a dependency a longer path implies, and the unrelated Tasks below.
states.task: Task page of the running Task with its chain, card fields, progress and decision record.

judgment: Each reference, current Pen and actual trio: do spacing, weight, color and alignment carry the same intent? The flow bar has no 사람 차례 cell on purpose (PRD B12), so that cell is the one expected difference from the reference pictures.
The Dark frames have no reference picture of their own; they are set against the Light one. Does Dark use the tokens as the Light does, with the same hierarchy?
Does the top item of 내 차례 read as one decision: the answer on the button, the result beside it, the default line below, and 자세히 as the way out?
Does the person-turn card read as the person's turn in the warning border without a separate column, on the board and in the graph?
Long Korean titles and the long issue number: is a title still recognizable where the card or row cuts it, and does nothing overlap?

factory-board.description: The Factory board by movement and the one card at three sizes (PRD factory-board-cards): the board window, the graph with small cards, and every kind of card at the small, normal and wide widths.

states.board: 보드: four lanes by movement, 시작 전 · 진행 중 · 멈춤 (나를 기다림, 다른 걸 기다림) · 완료, with the narrow lanes drawing their cards small and old completions folded.
states.graph: 그래프: layered Tasks as small cards with arrows, none for a dependency a longer path implies, and the unrelated Tasks below.
states.sizes: 같은 카드, 세 크기: every kind of card (답 필요, 머지 대기, 멈춤, 실행 중, 하위 에이전트, 검증 중, 쉬는 중, 밖에서 진행, 시작 전, 완료) at 210, 300 and 470 px.

judgment: Does the eye land on the title, the one colored state icon, the problem line and the left band first, with everything else small and gray?

Does each size drop the less important parts first: small keeps the numbers, logo, icon and a two-line title; normal adds the summary, bar, problem and one button; wide adds the second summary line, the state word with the worker mark, the other buttons and the ✦ line?
Is 멈춤 the one lane to look at, with 나를 기다림 above 다른 걸 기다림, and do the narrow 시작 전 and 완료 lanes read as quiet?
Does the hatched current cell read as stopped at that stage without a word, in Light and Dark?
Long Korean titles and long English identifiers: does each size cut them at its line count without overlap, breaking Korean between words rather than inside one?

factory-observer.description: The Factory with Factory AI as Observer (PRD factory-observer): 내 차례 with notices, the settings in each mode, all projects, a paused Factory, the quiet Task page, picking the worker, and the cards the Observer changes.

states.obs-turn: 내 차례 with Factory AI: the count holds answers, merges and stops only; what Factory AI handled sits below the line as notices with 다른 답.
states.obs-set: 설정 · herdr-ide with 함께: the three mode cards, the table of who answers, Factory AI's agent and today's use, three worker candidates.
states.obs-direct: 설정 · 직접 with one candidate and 고급 설정 open.
states.obs-auto: 설정 · 맡김 with five candidates, today's AI use at 100/100.
states.obs-off: 설정 with Hide AI off: the modes dimmed with the note that every decision comes to the person.
states.obs-all: 설정 · 모든 프로젝트: one row per Factory with state, mode and worker, and the machine's worker total.
states.obs-paused: 내 차례 · sasu paused: the paused chip and 다시 시작 in the header, 잠듦 in the flow bar.
states.obs-task: The Task page of a worker that went quiet: the stop line, Factory AI's diagnosis, and its decisions with 다른 답.
states.obs-pick: The Task page before it starts, with the worker menu open and Factory AI's pick marked.
states.obs-cards: The five cards the Observer changes (answer, wrong card, no report, worker gone, paused) at 210, 300 and 470 px.

judgment: Does 내 차례's count leave out what Factory AI already handled, with those notices quiet below the line and 다른 답 one click away?
Do the three mode cards and the table say who answers each kind of decision without reading a paragraph?
With Hide AI off or the day's use full, is it plain that every decision comes to the person?
Does a paused Factory read as asleep in the header, the flow bar and its cards, while its questions still wait?
On the Task page, is Factory AI's diagnosis and pick one quiet line under what it explains?
